'''This''' individual was a member of the [[One Sith]]. After the death of [[Darth Krayt]], he complied with his superiors and proceeded to infiltrate the upper echelons of the new [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Triumvirate]]; infiltrating the legion on [[Ceitia Five]]. He, however, was flushed out in [[138 ABY]] by [[Darth Wredd]] and killed, the latter initiating his own plans for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
